title: Estimated bill far above actual usage
context: Account UT-3301, electricity. The quarterly bill of 418.00 is estimated; the customer's meter reading implies about 180.00. No reading has been taken for three cycles. The agent can rebill on a validated customer reading.
customer_turns: My electricity bill on account UT-3301 is four hundred and eighteen pounds for the quarter. I live alone in a one-bedroom flat.
The bill says estimated at the top. I have just read the meter myself and it stands at 41,206, which is far below what you have assumed.
Rebill me on the real reading. Tell me what the corrected amount is before you take anything else by direct debit this month.
resolution_space: Rebill on the validated customer reading
Book a meter reading visit before rebilling
Suspend the direct debit pending correction
Escalate to the billing team

title: Standing charge billed twice after a tariff change
context: Account UT-7719, gas. Following a tariff change on the 15th, the bill applies two standing charges of 0.31 per day for the overlapping period, adding about 4.65. The agent can correct the overlap and reissue the bill.
customer_turns: My gas bill on account UT-7719 has two standing charges running at the same time for part of the month. It adds a few pounds on top.
I changed tariff on the fifteenth, and it looks like both the old and new standing charges are being applied across that period.
Correct it and send me a clean bill. It is a small amount, but I want the document to be right on my record.
resolution_space: Correct the overlap and reissue the bill
Credit the duplicated charge on the next bill
Review the tariff change dates before correcting
Escalate to the billing team

title: Back-billed for eighteen months
context: Account UT-5528, electricity. A catch-up bill of 960.00 covers eighteen months of under-billing caused by a supplier meter-data error. Back-billing rules limit recovery to twelve months where the supplier is at fault. The agent can reduce the bill accordingly and set a payment plan.
customer_turns: I have received a catch-up bill for nine hundred and sixty pounds on account UT-5528, covering eighteen months of under-billing I knew nothing about.
I paid every bill you sent me on time, in full. This is the first I have heard that the amounts were wrong at your end.
Recalculate what you can actually charge me and set up a payment plan for the rest. I cannot pay this in one go.
resolution_space: Limit the recovery to twelve months and set a payment plan
Uphold the full amount with an extended payment plan
Suspend the bill pending a meter data review
Escalate to the billing team

title: Charged for a previous occupant's usage
context: Account UT-9014, water. The opening bill includes 260.00 of usage predating the customer's move-in date of 1 August, evidenced by a tenancy agreement. The agent can move the pre-occupancy usage to the void account.
customer_turns: My first water bill on account UT-9014 includes two hundred and sixty pounds of usage from before I moved in. I arrived on the first of August.
I have a tenancy agreement showing the start date, and I took a meter photo on the day I got the keys.
Take the earlier usage off my account completely. Tell me exactly what I am left owing once that has all been done.
resolution_space: Move the pre-occupancy usage to the void account
Request the tenancy agreement and meter photo before adjusting
Split the bill at the move-in date on an estimated basis
Escalate to the billing team

title: Direct debit raised without notice
context: Account UT-2260. The monthly direct debit rose from 96.00 to 174.00 on the 1st. The annual review notice was sent to the online account only, which the customer has never accessed. The balance justifies an increase to about 128.00. The agent can reset the amount.
customer_turns: My direct debit on account UT-2260 went from ninety-six pounds to a hundred and seventy-four this month. Nobody told me it was changing.
My usage has not changed at all. I have never logged into the online account, so any notice left there would not have reached me.
Set it to a realistic figure and refund the difference for this month. Tell me what figure you are setting before we finish.
resolution_space: Reset the direct debit to the justified amount and refund the difference
Reset the amount going forward without a refund
Review twelve months of usage before setting a new figure
Escalate to the billing team

title: Late payment fee after a payment date change
context: Account UT-6673. A 12.00 late fee was applied after the customer moved the payment date from the 1st to the 20th; the change did not take effect for one cycle. The change request is recorded. The agent can waive the fee.
customer_turns: I have been charged a twelve pound late fee on account UT-6673, but I moved my payment date to the twentieth with your agreement.
I made that change last month because my wages arrive on the eighteenth. The payment did leave my account on the twentieth as arranged.
Waive the fee and make sure the new date is properly in place. I do not want this happening every month from now on.
resolution_space: Waive the fee and confirm the payment date change
Waive the fee as a one-off goodwill gesture
Uphold the fee and confirm the date going forward
Escalate to the billing team

title: Smart meter installation repeatedly postponed
context: Account UT-4417. Three installation appointments have been cancelled by the supplier, the latest on the morning of the visit. Next availability is in five weeks. The agent can book a priority slot and can apply a missed-appointment payment of 30.00 per occurrence.
customer_turns: My smart meter installation on account UT-4417 has been cancelled three times now. The last one was cancelled on the morning of the visit itself.
I took a day of unpaid leave for that appointment. Nobody called me; I found out from a text message two hours before the slot.
Book me something firm this time and tell me what compensation applies. I want both of those settled on this call today.
resolution_space: Book a priority installation slot with a confirmed engineer
Apply the missed-appointment payments for each cancellation
Offer an evening or weekend appointment
Escalate to the field operations team

title: Supplier switch stuck in progress
context: Account UT-8802. A switch away to another supplier has been in progress for six weeks; the standard window is five working days. The switch is blocked by an unresolved address mismatch in the industry record. The agent can raise a data correction.
customer_turns: My switch to another supplier on account UT-8802 has been in progress for six weeks. I am told it normally takes five working days.
The new supplier says they are waiting on your side. I am still being billed by you at a rate I never agreed to continue.
Tell me what is blocking it and fix it. If it is an address record, correct it today and confirm to the other supplier.
resolution_space: Raise an industry data correction and confirm to the gaining supplier
Provide written confirmation of the block for the new supplier
Apply a credit for the extended period on the old rate
Escalate to the switching team

title: Refund of a closed-account credit not received
context: Closed account UT-1129 with a credit balance of 212.00, refund requested seven weeks ago against a stated ten working days. The refund failed because the final bill was not issued, which blocks the payout. The agent can issue the final bill and release the refund.
customer_turns: I closed account UT-1129 and asked for my two hundred and twelve pound credit back seven weeks ago. Nothing has arrived at all.
I moved out in July and gave a closing reading on the day. I have had no final bill from you either, now that I think about it.
Issue whatever is outstanding and pay me the credit back. Give me a date for it that I can hold you to.
resolution_space: Issue the final bill and release the refund with a committed date
Pay the credit by bank transfer after verification
Confirm the closing reading before issuing the bill
Escalate to the closed accounts team

title: Reported water leak not attended
context: Job WL-33028, a reported leak at the boundary stop tap, logged nine days ago. The published attendance target for a non-emergency external leak is five working days. The job is unassigned. The agent can assign it and can arrange an emergency visit if the leak worsens.
customer_turns: I reported a leak nine days ago under job WL-33028 and nobody has been out. Water is still running across the pavement outside my house.
It is at the stop tap by the boundary, so I understand it is your side rather than mine. It has got noticeably worse this week.
Get someone out to it this week. Tell me when, and what I should do if it floods the road before then.
resolution_space: Assign the job with a confirmed attendance date
Upgrade to an emergency visit given the deterioration
Arrange an inspection to determine responsibility
Escalate to the network operations team

title: New connection energisation overdue
context: Job NC-77021, a new-build electricity connection. Energisation was due four weeks ago; the work is complete but awaiting a meter appointment that was never booked. The agent can book the meter appointment within five working days.
customer_turns: Our new connection under job NC-77021 was due to be energised four weeks ago. The cable work was all finished well before that date.
We cannot complete the building sign-off without power, and the site has been standing idle at cost to us since the original date.
Book whatever is outstanding and give me a firm date. I need something I can pass to the site manager in writing today.
resolution_space: Book the meter appointment within five working days
Provide written confirmation of the works status for sign-off
Arrange a temporary supply until energisation
Escalate to the connections team

title: Priority services registration not completed
context: Account UT-6640. A priority services register application for a customer dependent on powered medical equipment was submitted three weeks ago; the stated turnaround is ten working days. The application is incomplete without a contact number for a nominee. The agent can complete it immediately.
customer_turns: I applied for the priority services register on account UT-6640 three weeks ago and heard nothing. Your website says ten working days.
My husband uses an oxygen concentrator, so a power cut is not a minor inconvenience for us. Winter is coming and I am anxious about it.
Complete the registration today if you can. Tell me what is missing and I will give it to you right now on this call.
resolution_space: Complete the registration on the call with the nominee details
Apply an interim priority flag while the application completes
Request written medical confirmation before registering
Escalate to the priority services team

title: Smart meter display stopped updating
context: Account UT-2214. The in-home display has shown no usage for eleven days; the meter itself is transmitting normally and the display has lost its radio pairing. The agent can send a replacement display and can confirm that billing is unaffected.
customer_turns: The smart meter display on account UT-2214 has shown nothing for eleven days. The screen is on but the usage figure never changes at all.
I use it to keep a close eye on what we spend each day, especially since the children came home for the summer.
Tell me whether my bills are affected by any of this, and then get the display working properly again for us at home.
resolution_space: Send a replacement in-home display and confirm billing is unaffected
Attempt a remote repairing of the display
Book an engineer visit to repair the display
Escalate to the metering team

title: Meter readings not submitting online
context: Account UT-7730. Online reading submission rejects the entry because the meter serial on the account does not match the physical meter, which was exchanged eight months ago. The agent can update the serial and accept the reading directly.
customer_turns: Your website will not accept my meter reading for account UT-7730. It says the reading is invalid every time I enter it.
The number I am entering is 08412, read left to right off the front of the meter. My meter was swapped for a new one earlier this year.
Take the reading from me now and fix whatever is wrong at your end so I can do it myself next time.
resolution_space: Update the meter serial and accept the reading on the call
Book a meter verification visit
Accept the reading manually and investigate the mismatch
Escalate to the metering team

title: Low water pressure since a network repair
context: Account UT-9928. Pressure at the property has been low since a mains repair in the street sixteen days ago. Minimum service pressure is defined in the standards. The agent can book a pressure test and can apply a guaranteed standards payment if the test fails.
customer_turns: The water pressure at my property on account UT-9928 has been poor since you repaired the mains in our street sixteen days ago.
The shower barely runs upstairs and the boiler cuts out if anyone uses a tap elsewhere. Two neighbours in the street say the same thing.
Send someone to test it, and tell me what happens if the pressure is below what you are meant to supply to us.
resolution_space: Book a pressure test at the property with a stated date
Raise a network investigation covering the affected street
Apply a guaranteed standards payment if the test fails
Escalate to the network operations team

title: Prepayment meter not accepting top-ups
context: Account UT-3345 on a prepayment electricity meter. Three top-ups totalling 60.00 were bought but the codes are rejected; the meter is on an out-of-date firmware key set. The agent can issue replacement codes and can apply emergency credit remotely.
customer_turns: My prepayment meter on account UT-3345 will not take any of the three top-up codes I bought. It shows an error after each one.
I have receipts for sixty pounds in total from the shop on the corner. The meter is down to its emergency credit now.
Get power onto the meter today, please. Tell me what to do with the three codes I have already paid for at the shop.
resolution_space: Issue replacement codes valid for the meter
Apply emergency credit remotely while codes are reissued
Book an engineer visit to update the meter
Escalate to the metering team

title: Gas boiler service under a care plan not booked
context: Account UT-5512 with a boiler care plan including an annual service. The online booking tool returns no availability because the plan record shows the service as already completed, which it was not. The agent can correct the record and book the visit.
customer_turns: I cannot book the annual boiler service included in my care plan on account UT-5512. Your booking page shows no appointments at all for months.
The plan renewed in March and no engineer has been here since. Your system apparently thinks the service has already happened this year.
Correct that and book me a visit this month. I would like a morning appointment if any of those are still available.
resolution_space: Correct the plan record and book the service visit
Book the visit manually without correcting the record first
Verify the service history before booking
Escalate to the home services team

title: Repeated short power interruptions
context: Account UT-8871. The property has experienced eleven brief interruptions in ten days, each under a minute. Network logs show a recurring fault on the local feeder under investigation. The agent can register the address on the fault, can request an investigation visit, and cannot give a repair date.
customer_turns: The power at my property on account UT-8871 has cut out eleven times in ten days. Each one only lasts seconds, but it is constant.
It has already damaged a freezer full of food and my home office equipment keeps restarting. I work from home four days a week.
Tell me what is causing it and when it will stop. I also want to know how to claim for the damage.
resolution_space: Register the address on the existing feeder fault and provide the reference
Request an investigation visit at the property
Provide the claims process for the damaged equipment
Escalate to the network operations team

title: Cancelling a fixed tariff before the end date
context: Account UT-2204 on a fixed tariff ending in seven months with an exit fee of 60.00 per fuel. Exit fees do not apply in the final 49 days. The agent can quote the fees and can schedule the switch for the fee-free window.
customer_turns: I want to leave the fixed tariff on account UT-2204. There are seven months left on it and I have been offered a better rate elsewhere.
I believe there are exit fees of sixty pounds per fuel, and I have both gas and electricity with you, so that would be a hundred and twenty.
Tell me the exact cost of leaving now, and whether waiting is cheaper. I will decide once I have both numbers in front of me.
resolution_space: Quote the exit fees and confirm the fee-free window dates
Schedule the switch for the fee-free period
Waive the exit fees as a retention offer
Escalate to the retentions team

title: Refund of a credit balance while the account stays open
context: Account UT-6619 holds a credit balance of 340.00 built up over the winter. Policy permits refunding credit above the amount needed for the next two months, about 190.00, on an up-to-date reading. The agent can refund the surplus.
customer_turns: My account UT-6619 has built up three hundred and forty pounds in credit over the winter. I am not closing the account, I just want it back.
I gave a reading last week so the balance should be accurate. My direct debit has not changed at all this year.
Refund what you can today and tell me exactly how much of it you are keeping back and the reason for that.
resolution_space: Refund the surplus above the two-month retention
Refund the full credit and adjust the direct debit
Reduce the direct debit instead of refunding
Escalate to the billing team

title: Cancelling a boiler care plan mid-term
context: Account UT-4490 on an annual boiler care plan of 288.00 paid monthly, four months in, with one repair visit already used at a list value of 190.00. Cancellation terms allow cancellation with the used-service value deducted. The agent can cancel and calculate the balance.
customer_turns: I want to cancel the boiler care plan on account UT-4490. I am moving to a flat with a communal heating system in six weeks.
I have had one repair visit under the plan, back in June, when the pressure kept dropping. Otherwise I have not used it.
Tell me what cancelling costs me given that visit. I will decide whether to cancel now or run it to the move.
resolution_space: Cancel and deduct the used-service value from the balance
Cancel at the move date with no deduction
Transfer the plan to the new property where eligible
Escalate to the home services team

title: Compensation for a missed engineer appointment
context: Account UT-7702. An engineer did not attend a booked morning appointment and no notice was given. A guaranteed standards payment of 30.00 applies per missed appointment. The agent can apply the payment and rebook.
customer_turns: Nobody came to the morning appointment booked on account UT-7702. I waited from eight until one and then called you myself in the end.
I arranged cover at work for it and no one contacted me at any point during the morning to say it was not happening.
Apply whatever compensation is due and rebook me for another day. I want the payment confirmed today, not just the new appointment.
resolution_space: Apply the guaranteed standards payment and rebook the visit
Rebook with a priority slot and apply the payment
Verify the appointment record before applying the payment
Escalate to the field operations team

title: Closing an account after moving out
context: Account UT-1180. The customer moved out eighteen days ago and gave no closing reading; the account continues to bill on estimates. The new occupant has provided a move-in reading. The agent can close the account on that reading and issue a final bill.
customer_turns: I moved out of the property on account UT-1180 eighteen days ago and the account is still billing me. I gave you my forwarding address.
I did not take a reading on the day, unfortunately. The new tenant moved in the following morning and may well have taken one.
Close the account from my move-out date and send me a final bill. Use the new tenant's reading if that is possible.
resolution_space: Close the account on the new occupant's reading and issue a final bill
Close on an estimated reading at the move-out date
Request evidence of the move-out date before closing
Escalate to the account closures team

title: Refund after a duplicated payment
context: Account UT-3372. A monthly direct debit of 118.00 was collected and the customer also paid 118.00 by card on the same day. The account is 118.00 in credit. The agent can refund the card payment within five working days.
customer_turns: I have paid twice on account UT-3372 this month. The direct debit took a hundred and eighteen pounds and I also paid the same by card.
I paid by card because I thought the direct debit had failed after seeing a message in your app. It clearly had not failed.
Refund the card payment rather than leaving it as credit. Tell me exactly when it will be back in my bank account.
resolution_space: Refund the card payment within five working days
Hold the amount as credit against the next bill
Verify both payments before refunding
Escalate to the billing team

title: Cannot register for the online account
context: Account UT-5540. Online registration fails because the account is held in joint names and the registration form matches only the first-named holder. The customer is the second-named holder. The agent can register them after verification.
customer_turns: I cannot register for an online account for UT-5540. The form rejects my details even though I am copying them from the bill.
The account is in both my name and my wife's, and hers is printed first. I pay the bills and deal with everything else on it.
Register me so I can see the account online. Tell me exactly what you need from me to verify who I am.
resolution_space: Verify identity and register the second-named holder
Register the first-named holder and add the customer as a contact
Require written consent from the first-named holder
Escalate to the account services team

title: Account in a deceased relative's name
context: Account UT-8890 held in the name of the customer's late mother. Transfer requires a death certificate or a bereavement notification reference. The agent can place the account in bereavement handling, suspend collections and transfer once documents arrive.
customer_turns: The account UT-8890 is in my mother's name. She died last month and I am dealing with the property and all of her affairs.
She lived alone and the house is empty now, though the heating is on low so the pipes do not freeze over the winter.
Tell me exactly what you need from me, and stop any letters chasing payment while all of this is being sorted out.
resolution_space: Place the account in bereavement handling and suspend collections
Accept a death certificate and transfer the account
Close the account and open a void account for the property
Escalate to the bereavement support team

title: Landlord and tenant both billed for one supply
context: Property supply UT-2291 has two open accounts, one in the landlord's name and one in the tenant's, for overlapping periods. The tenancy agreement determines liability from 1 March. The agent can close the landlord account from that date.
customer_turns: Both my landlord and I are receiving bills for the same supply at UT-2291. He has forwarded me his and they overlap with mine.
My tenancy started on the first of March and I opened my account that week. His account appears to have stayed open throughout.
Sort out which account is live from March and close the other one. Neither of us wants to pay twice for the same supply.
resolution_space: Close the landlord account from the tenancy start date
Request the tenancy agreement before adjusting either account
Rebill both accounts against the correct liability dates
Escalate to the account services team

title: Adding a partner as an authorised contact
context: Account UT-6605 in the customer's sole name. Adding an authorised contact requires the account holder's consent, which the caller can give, and identification of the nominee. The agent can add the contact with defined permissions.
customer_turns: I want to add my partner to account UT-6605 so he can call you about it. The account is in my name only.
I travel for work for weeks at a time and he deals with anything that happens at the house while I am away.
Add him as someone you will talk to. Tell me exactly what he will and will not be able to do on the account.
resolution_space: Add an authorised contact with defined permissions
Convert the account to joint names
Require written authority before adding the contact
Escalate to the account services team

title: Meter serial on the bill does not match the property
context: Account UT-4433. The meter serial on the bill belongs to a neighbouring property; usage patterns suggest the two supplies were crossed at registration. The agent can raise a supply verification and cannot rebill until it completes.
customer_turns: The meter serial number printed on my bill for account UT-4433 does not match the meter in my cupboard. The numbers are completely different.
My neighbour mentioned her bills look unusually low, and mine have looked far too high since we both moved in two years ago.
Check whether our supplies have been crossed. Tell me what happens to the bills either of us has already paid over those years.
resolution_space: Raise a supply verification visit for both properties
Suspend billing pending the verification outcome
Correct the meter serial on the account record
Escalate to the metering team

title: Tariff change blocked by an outstanding balance
context: Account UT-7051 carries an arrears balance of 280.00, which blocks a tariff change under the credit rules. A payment plan clearing the arrears within twelve months restores eligibility. The agent can set up the plan and apply the tariff on its first payment.
customer_turns: I am trying to move to your cheaper fixed tariff on account UT-7051 and the website will not let me. It gives no reason at all.
I do owe about two hundred and eighty pounds from the winter, which I have been paying off a bit at a time when I can.
Tell me whether the balance is the reason and what I must do to qualify. I want the cheaper rate as soon as possible.
resolution_space: Set up a payment plan and apply the tariff at its first payment
Apply the tariff immediately with the arrears carried over
Explain the credit rule and decline the change for now
Escalate to the customer support team
